properties.author: Apache Tomcat Project
properties.title: End of support for Apache Tomcat Native 1.3.x

section.name: End of support for Apache Tomcat Native 1.3.x
section.p: The Apache Tomcat® team announces that support for Apache Tomcat Native 1.3.x will end on 31 March 2027.

ul.li: releases from the 1.3.x branch are highly unlikely
bugs affecting only the 1.3.x branch will not be addressed
security vulnerability reports will not be checked against the 1.3.x branch

section.p: Three months later (i.e. some time after 30 June 2027):

ul.li: the 1.3.x download pages will be removed
the latest 1.3.x release will be removed from the mirror system
the links to the 1.3.x documentation will be removed from tomcat.apache.org

section.p: Note that all 1.3.x releases will always be available from the archive.
